content: Flutter list screen states: skeleton placeholders for first-load (feel faster than spinners), centered progress only for first page, bottom-of-list inline progress indicator while fetching next page, explicit empty-state widget when the collection is genuinely empty, and a first-page error state with a retry action (network failures are normal, never silently swallow them). Pull-to-refresh should reset both data and the end-of-list flag. Packages like infinite_scroll_pagination give slot-based builders for progress/error/empty/end-of-list out of the box.
